name: Venom Strike

specialAbility.name: Poison
specialAbility.description: Venom Strike spits glowing green poison that burns the enemy truck for 10 damage over 3 turns!

lore: Venom Strike slithered out of a toxic swamp covered in glowing green slime and with fangs dripping poison! This dark purple nightmare has snake eyes on its hood and leaves a trail of green goo wherever it goes. Get hit by its Poison attack and you will be melting for turns!
